caption: The drawing features two detailed renderings of fabric head coverings, both depicted in fine, precise graphite lines on a beige or off-white background. The larger head covering, positioned in the upper left quadrant, is decorated with multiple bands or layers of different patterns, including floral motifs, lines of dots, and lace-like edges. The fabric appears to be folded and layered, creating a sense of depth and texture. The edges are scalloped, and intricate details are visible within each section. The smaller head covering, located below and to the right of the larger one, also shows banded patterns and folds, but is more compact in form. It includes a rectangular-textured crown and tiered sides that fall in short, gathered layers. Both objects are sketched with careful attention to ornamental details. The artist's signature, "Roberta S. Spicer," appears in small lettering in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Cap
